items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: the biggest puff I've ever seen is Mutt Carey and this boy that called Dizzy Gillespie.

ctx.x: Staccato style. Yeah, yeah. More stasplato. Yeah, stasplato, yeah. Do you notice many guys puffing their cheeks out in those days when they played?

Well, I puffed not myself, but the biggest puff I've ever seen is Mutt Carey and this boy that called Dizzy Gillespie. Dizzy Gillespie would go like that. Mutt Carey couldn't butt in the shite chair. He couldn't butt in there. He'd bust all that.
I noticed Frankie Asunto puffs a lot. Yeah. Yeah.
